answer: knoll admits a zenith only after it posts a bond of pearl against every live zenith, sized by that resident's current bond count plus one; knoll rewrites all degrees at commit and rejects batches. The kth zenith posts (k-1)^2 pearl, so a thousand admissions post about 333 million pearl, each attached to a pairwise entry that no clone can reuse. It breaks if bonds are refundable or knoll can be forked.
